title: Magnetic Induction Culinary Cauldron with 4-Wire PT100 Core Probe & Gravimetric Load Cell
description: Canonical Layer 2 sensor and actuator register schema for communal soup kettles and 24-hour collagen bone-broth vessels enforcing Bigelow F0 pathogen lethality.

registers.name: core_temp_mk
registers.si_equivalent: millikelvin (347150 mK = 74.00 C pasteurization floor; 373150 mK = 100.00 C boil)
registers.description: Liquid geometric-center temperature measured via Class-A 4-wire PT100 RTD probe in millikelvin.

registers.name: heater_power_mw
registers.description: Commanded and actively regulated magnetic induction coil power in milliwatts.

registers.name: volume_ml
registers.si_equivalent: milliliters derived from tare-subtracted strain-gauge load cell
registers.description: Net liquid/stew contents volume in milliliters (0..40,000 ml for 40L 304-stainless stockpot).

registers.name: pasteurization_hold_s
registers.si_equivalent: seconds held continuously at core_temp_mk >= 347150 mK
registers.description: Monotonic dwell counter in seconds incremented while core_temp_mk >= 347150 mK (74.0 C). Resets to 0 if contents enter the 277150..333150 mK danger zone prior to completion.

safety_invariants.rationale: Hard boil-dry cutoff prevents vessel warping, scorched legumes, and induction glass thermal shock.
Enforces >= 7-log Salmonella/Listeria Bigelow lethality before communal R0/R1 tiffin packaging.
Core temperature exceeding 112 C in an unpressurized stockpot indicates dry scorching and trips solid-state contactor.
Kitchen sovereignty guaranteed: verification uses strictly thermodynamic RTD (mK) and gravimetric (ml) telemetry.
